# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 73 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 73 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_073_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Part 4 — The Commission and Departure

**73:1** "Lord," I asked, "what about those who turned in rods that were green and were found to still be green — who are those people?" "Those," he said, "are the ones who have always feared God, who have kept his commandments and never wavered in any way. These are the ones who will live in the first tower."

**73:2** Once he had finished explaining all the rods, he said to me: "Go, tell everyone to repent — and they will live for God. The Lord is full of compassion, and he sent me to give repentance to all — especially to those who have sinned the most. The Lord wants everyone who was called by his great and holy name to be saved."

**73:3** When he had finished speaking with me, the two young men who had been with him came and took him away toward the east. As he was leaving, he was laughing. He called back to me as he went: "Keep fighting!"

**73:4** I woke up and wrote down everything I had been shown. I was filled with joy — because what I had seen was great and glorious. As I woke up I said: "The Lord hasn't forgotten me. He's shown me his grace."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the joy and commission at the close of Similitude 8.*
